Create a new agent flow.

--name is required unless --file supplies a top-level "name". Flags always
win over the file's fields when both are set. The server may store a
different name than requested if it collides with an existing one (it
silently appends " 1", " 2", etc.) — the stored name is always shown.

Usage:
  plivo agents create [flags]

Examples:
  plivo agents create --name "Order Status Agent"
  plivo agents create --name "Order Status Agent" --file flow.json
  plivo agents create --file flow.json   # flow.json supplies "name" itself

Flags:
      --description string   agent description
      --file string          JSON file with the flow graph ({name, description, nodes, connections}); flags win over its fields
  -h, --help                 help for create
      --name string          agent name (required unless --file supplies one)

Global Flags:
      --all                auto-paginate through all pages
      --dry-run            print the HTTP request without sending
      --explain            explain what the command will do before executing
      --log-level string   log level: debug|info|warn|error|none (default "warn")
      --no-color           disable colored output
  -o, --output string      output format: table|json (default: table for TTY, json otherwise)
      --profile string     named profile from ~/.plivo/config.toml
  -q, --quiet              suppress non-data output
      --timeout int        request timeout in seconds (default 30)
  -y, --yes                skip confirmation prompts
